purpose: Test whether a publicly influential calibration node reduces P11 opportunity cost relative to the frozen low-degree selector.

arms.low: Frozen P11 low-degree selector, one complete informative node, prompt sequence 1/2/3, cost 6.
arms.high: Independent subclass preselects one node by descending public component influence, then distance from opinion bounds and ID; all other P11 behavior is frozen.
arms.p9_no_probe: Unchanged P9 ZIP without prompt probes.

shared_eligibility: Scanned live peace/neutral node, comm_left=3, opinion strictly inside [-60,60].
selection_coupling: Report first action divergence and communications later erased by shielding; do not interpret high-low as probe damage alone because learned magnitude can reorder communication and structure actions.
gate: high-minus-low symmetric mean greater than 1 terminal unit
high-minus-low mean in prompt-1-best cases greater than 0
at least four of six family means are nonnegative
minimum paired high-minus-low delta is at least -10
all 36 cases have equal probe cost 6, correct prompt identification, and zero action/planning/runtime failures
decision: Passing is development screening only. Do not combine with the separately tested 0.9 unknown-prior discount and do not open repetitions 1401-1403.
